name: Base-ic Instinct
description: I stumbled upon this peculiar string: 'ZmxhZ3t0aGlzX2lzX2Jhc2U2NF9lbmNvZGVkfQ=='. It appears to be encoded. Can you decipher it?
hints: This is Base64 encoding. Use an online decoder or a command-line tool to decode it.

name: Source Sleuth
description: I've crafted a website where the flag is cleverly concealed. Can you uncover it? Visit https://zachflower.github.io/ctfd-challenge-assets/source-sleuth/ and prove your sleuthing skills.
hints: Right-click on the webpage and select 'View Page Source' or use your browser's developer tools to inspect the HTML.

name: Cookie Monster
description: C is for Cookie, that's good enough for me... or is it? Visit https://zachflower.github.io/ctfd-challenge-assets/cookie-monster/ and manipulate the cookies to reveal the truth.
hints: Use your browser's developer tools to edit the cookie and then refresh the page.

name: Hidden Gadget
description: A website harbors a secret message, invisible to the naked eye. Visit https://zachflower.github.io/ctfd-challenge-assets/hidden-gadget/ and use your inspection skills to unveil it.
hints: Use your browser's developer tools to inspect the page elements and find the hidden content.

name: JS Jiggler
description: Behold a calculator that multiplies two numbers to unlock secrets. Visit https://zachflower.github.io/ctfd-challenge-assets/js-jiggler/ and find the correct pair.
hints: Find two numbers whose product is 42. Check the browser console after calculating.

name: Web Weaver
description: A web page woven with riddles and obfuscated code awaits. Visit https://zachflower.github.io/ctfd-challenge-assets/web-weaver/ and unravel the mystery to claim the flag.
hints: Solve the riddle, decode the base64 obfuscated answer and flag parts in the JavaScript code, and check your browser notifications.

name: EXIF-tastic
description: A seemingly innocent photo of my cat hides secrets in its metadata. View the image at https://zachflower.github.io/ctfd-challenge-assets/exif-tastic/kitty-kitty.jpg and extract the hidden flag.
hints: Use an online EXIF viewer or a command-line tool like 'exiftool' to inspect the image's metadata.

name: String Theory
description: A mysterious file from a friend contains the flag within. Download it at https://zachflower.github.io/ctfd-challenge-assets/string-theory/challenge and use your reverse engineering prowess to extract it.
hints: The 'strings' command in Linux can be used to find printable strings in a binary file.

name: Hidden in Plain Sight
description: An image appears ordinary, but a message lurks within. View it at https://zachflower.github.io/ctfd-challenge-assets/plain-sight/steg.jpg and employ steganography to reveal the secret.
hints: Use the 'steghide' command-line tool to extract hidden data from the image. 'steghide extract -sf <filename>'

name: Caesar Shift
description: Behold a cryptic message shrouded in mystery: 'mshn{aopz_pz_h_zljyla_tlzzhnl}'. Unravel the shift and unveil its hidden truth.
hints: Caesar cipher shifts letters by a fixed amount.

name: Hex Decoder
description: Unlock the enigma within this string: 666c61677b6865785f69735f66756e7d. Decode it to reveal the concealed flag.
